title: Toolbar with toggle buttons and roving focus
when: The user wants a row of tool buttons, such as bold, italic and align for an editor, or view and sort actions above a list.
inputs: the actions and which ones are on and off toggles
prompt:
Goal: A WAI-ARIA toolbar that is a single Tab stop, moves with arrow keys and shows toggle state with aria-pressed.
Steps:
1. <div role="toolbar" aria-label="Text formatting" aria-controls="editor"> of <button type="button"> items, related ones wrapped in <div role="group" aria-label="Alignment">.
2. Roving tabindex: the last used button has tabindex="0", every other one "-1", so the toolbar costs one Tab press.
3. ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move focus with wrap; Home and End jump to the first and last button.
4. Toggles such as Bold carry aria-pressed="true" or "false"; in an exclusive set (left, center, right) pressing one releases the others.
5. Icon buttons get an aria-label and an SVG with aria-hidden="true"; disabled ones use aria-disabled and stay reachable.
6. On narrow screens move rare actions into a More menu button instead of wrapping into rows.
Quality bar:
- Pressed state shows as a filled background, not only a color shift.
- Buttons are at least 44 px square.
- Focus stays on the button after it acts.
Pitfalls:
- Every button left in the Tab order.
- Flipping the label (Bold to Not bold) instead of using aria-pressed.
- Buttons that vanish when disabled, shifting the others.
Verify:
- [ ] role="toolbar" with an aria-label.
- [ ] Exactly one button has tabindex 0.
- [ ] Arrows, Home and End move focus.
- [ ] aria-pressed matches each toggle.
Output: Toolbar markup, toolbar.css and toolbar.js.

examples.input: barra de ferramentas do editor com negrito, italico e alinhamento
examples.output: role toolbar Text formatting, Bold and Italic with aria-pressed, exclusive align group, one Tab stop, arrows move
